scope: Owner-requested post-outcome descriptive aggregation of exact source-native NoTool FormatError feedback in the twelve ORIGINAL runs only. No CIs, hypothesis test, primary score update or causal estimate.
denominator: Available internal Harbor trials, including internal retries; not complete logical evaluation runs, provider responses or all planned task cells. Replacements and production top-ups excluded. Event count is feedback messages, not individual normal-answer-stop classifications.
interpretation: A0 has about34% more NoTool feedback events per available trial than v0.1, but a lower share of trials affected. This is more repeated recovery feedback in the observed A0 sample, not evidence of a higher trial-level incidence or proof that BFCL's normal-answer-stop habit caused it. Rejected provider text/finish remain unavailable; trial lengths, opportunities, internal retries and infrastructure-censored task coverage differ.
unknowns: 618 of1200 original model/slot/task cells unavailable, not zero. First actual provider-response no-call remains UNKNOWN for all617 available trials. No causal rescue frequency, raw HTTP reconstruction or release inference.
method: Group all corrected report trial rows by model, count exact NoTool event indices and trials with any such index, divide by the number of available internal trials; cross-check cohort actual_trials sums. Source file SHA checked before aggregation.
